summary: Part 2 (05:21-12:05) of the 3.1 Buybox (Sellers) video. The trainer walks through the Buybox tab of the 'Buybox Training' Google Sheet: what TRUE/FALSE in Wins AE/SA means, where sellers enter Price AE and Price SA, the hourly refresh, the No bid and Fulfillment statuses, the Monthly Sales filter, and Minimum prices (Min AE/Min SA), which keep a seller's price updating until it wins. Screen values are mostly clear. Unclear: the currency used for Saudi Arabia, whether sheet prices (892) equal decimal prices (8.92), the 'Centrof' file name, the Score rule, the cell used for the Saudi example, and a few garbled sentences.

asr_fixes.basis: Screen: frame t00456.jpg shows the Buybox AE cell reading 'No bid'.
Screen: frame t00496.jpg shows Q5 reading '190 - Fulfillment'.
Transcription fix only. The trainer says 'drop your price here to 8.40' at 10:18. The sheet shows 840 in U527 (frame t00647.jpg), so the decimal form is the trainer's reading, not the sheet's.

unclear.issue: 'the data will be sent to the Centrof file every {1?} hour'. The file name 'Centrof' is not shown on screen and the words are unreliable. The hourly refresh is stated repeatedly elsewhere, so only the file name is unclear.
Currency: the trainer says '1 dirham cheaper in Saudi Arabia' and '1 dirham cheaper than the buy box for Saudi Arabia'. The sheet shows no currency, so the Saudi unit is not confirmed.

Input cell: the trainer says he put 502 for the Saudi price of row 243, but the Saudi price is the Price SA column (V). In frame t00390.jpg the name box reads R243 (Buybox SA, a column with a formula-driven value) with formula bar 502. Which cell was typed into is not clear from the frames.

Timing: the trainer says Wins AE turns TRUE one hour after the entry (07:52), but frame t00476.jpg shows S2 Wins AE = TRUE in the same frame as the new price. It is unclear whether TRUE appeared immediately or after a refresh.

Price units: the trainer speaks in decimals (8.92, 8.42, 10.21, 10.16, 8.39, 10.14), but the sheet shows integers (892, 842, 1021, 1016, 839, 1014). The rule linking the two is not stated, and the trainer calls 503 to 502 '1 dirham' while the sheet difference is one unit. Confirm the unit before a KAM quotes a number.

Score rule: 'the lowest condition when the score does not impact the price and that the competition is made only on the price' is garbled. The diagram says 'Score affecting prices' (Performance & Score to Buybox) and 'Score > 0% > price increase' (to Fulfillment App). These conflict, so the score effect on price is not confirmed.
'which is a way in UAE to {the?} prices' is garbled. The meaning of the sentence after 'fulfillment' is not confirmed.

'If you {no?} prices here but you have prices in the minimum columns {it?} will update automatically'. The gist (minimum prices alone still update the price) is stated as medium confidence. The exact wording is not confirmed.

The filter dropdown shows 10-20 and 20-50 ticked and the OK button. In the frame after OK (t00449.jpg), rows with 0-1 and 3-5 are still visible. It is unclear whether the filter was applied in the sheet.

Fulfillment App tile: the first country icon is an X and the other two are flags. The meaning of the X (for example, fulfillment not offered there) is not stated by the trainer and cannot be confirmed from the icon.
The 'Locked' suffix on Buybox SA and Neutral cells (e.g. 582 - Locked) is not explained in this part.
